container.name: projects
container.query: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.abbreviation AS displayName, c.description, c.proponentName AS proponent, c.sector, c.projectState AS status, c.region, c.eagleId AS legacyEagleId, c.centroid, c.read, c.isPublished, c._ts FROM c WHERE c._ts >= @HighWaterMark ORDER BY c._ts
